teams.title: Teams
teams.intro: When a whole team does the work, the credit usually lands on the one or two people the giver happens to know by name. Teams are an attempt to fix that: recognise the group itself, and the thanks reach everyone behind the work — including the people you could not have named.
teams.intro_self: Teams here are self-organised — you do not need anyone's permission to start one.
teams.how_start: Anyone can start a team. No admin approval, no owner, no application to fill in.
teams.how_invite: Is your team missing? Create it, then invite the others by their Kudos username — or share its page on your mailing list or chat so they can ask to join.
teams.how_manage: The team then runs itself: any member approves the people waiting to join, and anyone can leave or tidy the roster. Requests nobody answers are approved automatically after 14 days.
teams.how_badge: Want a badge for your team? Propose one in {repo} on GitHub. Once it is added, an admin can link it to your team and everyone on the roster gets it.
teams.find_or_start: Find your team — or start a new one
teams.find_or_start_sub: Type a name to search. If no team matches, you can create it right here.
teams.search_placeholder: Type a team name, e.g. agama
teams.create_idle: No team for your group yet? Type its name above and you can create it here.
teams.create_note: You will be its first member. Invite the others from the team card, or let them ask to join.
teams.empty: No teams yet — be the first to start one.
teams.pending_count: nobody waiting | 1 waiting for approval | {count} waiting for approval
teams.review_requests: Review request | Review request | Review {count} requests
teams.remove_hint: Any member can remove any member. Every change is logged and the person is notified.
teams.confirm_remove: Remove {name} from {team}? They will be notified.
teams.confirm_leave: Leave {team}? You will be listed as a former member and can rejoin any time.
teams.badge_tbd_hint: No badge linked to this team yet. Propose one in openSUSE/kudos-badges on GitHub, then ask an admin to link it.
teams.empty_roster: No members yet — this team is waiting for its first joiner.

teams.invite_hint: Anyone who has logged in to Kudos with their openSUSE account can be invited. They get an email and join once they accept.
teams.invite_approved: {name} had already asked to join — they are now a member.
